reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and my reaction is that anyone can print that; I look for an NSF or USP seal and there isn't one. A new brand with zero reviews won't displace the magnesium I already have on Subscribe & Save.
objection: No NSF or USP certification and no reviews. A named lab report is better than nothing, but I can't tell who is paying that lab or whether the report is really for the batch in my box. And it's about $1 a serving, which is a lot more than what I pay now.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF Certified or USP Verified mark on the box, plus a few hundred real verified reviews, at a price closer to $20 for 30.
